map.防护用品更换提醒 使用指南: Protective Equipment Replacement Reminder User Guide
map.记录劳动防护用品的更换日期与周期，自动计算到期时间并提醒，支持清单导出，数据保存: Record the replacement date and cycle of labour protection equipment, automatically computing the due date and reminding you, with list export; data stays in the local browser for safety management.
map.录入防护用品上次更换日期与建议周期，自动提示下次更换时间。: Enter the date the protective equipment was last replaced and its recommended cycle, and it reports when it is next due.
map.对临期/逾期用品标红提醒，避免超期使用失效。: Flag items nearing or past expiry in red to avoid using them beyond their life.
map.按用品类别（滤棉、耳塞、手套等）分批跟踪。: Track in batches by item category (filter cotton, ear plugs, gloves etc.).
map.：下次更换 = 上次更换日期 + 建议周期(天)；剩余天数 = 下次 − 今天；: Next replacement = last replacement date + recommended cycle (days); days remaining = next - today; remaining at or below 0 means overdue, and 7 days or fewer triggers an expiring reminder. Set the cycle from the item instructions or company rules, such as 30 days for dust filter cotton, 90-180 days for ear plugs and 30 months for a hard hat shell.
map.：防尘口罩滤棉上次更换 2026-08-20、周期 30 天，下次 2026-0: For a dust mask filter last replaced on 2026-08-20 with a 30-day cycle, the next is 2026-09-19; safety shoes on a 365-day cycle last replaced 2026-01-10 are next due 2027-01-10; ear protectors on a 135-day cycle last replaced 2026-06-01 are next due 2026-10-14, with reminders starting 7 days ahead.

map.以产品说明与行业/企业安全制度为准；受污染、破损或过期不论是否到期都应提前更换。: Follow the product instructions and the company's safety rules; anything contaminated, damaged or expired should be replaced early whether or not it has passed its date.
map.临期提醒后还能用几天？: How Many Days After an Expiry Reminder Can It Still Be Used?
map.临期仅作预警，逾期即应停用更换；涉及呼吸防护等关键的，建议到期前完成换新不留空档: Expiry is only a warning; once past it the item must be taken out of service and replaced. For critical items such as respiratory protection, replace before expiry so there is no gap.
